description: Scan text for acronyms (2-10 character all-caps tokens) and flag any that are used before being expanded on first mention, per standard technical writing style guides. Recognizes both expansion conventions: the full term followed by the acronym in parentheses, and the acronym followed by its expansion in parentheses. Pure regex heuristic, not a dictionary of real acronyms.

text.description: The text to scan for acronym expansion order

name: check_acronym_expansion
